Vihan Kanwal --_ Petitioner
Versus
State Of Punjab And Anr .... Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Moudgil

Present: Mr. Pankaj Bali, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Rajiv Verma, Dag, Punjab.
Mr. Akashdeep Miglani, Advocate for the complainant.
3 2k 2c 2c
Sandeep Moudgil, J (Oral)

The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., for grant of
anticipatory bail in case Fir No.44 dated 31.03.2024 registered for offences punishable under
Sections 420/467/468/471/120-B Ipc at Police Station Khanna City, Khanna.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegations even if taken to be true on the fact would reveal civil liability and no criminal act can be attributed on the factual aspect as narrated in the FIR.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that as per the story putforth by the complainant which is highly improbable that despite having compromised the matter which was reduced in writing on 07.03.2022 settling the dispute and a cancellation report filed by the police official on 12.03.2022 duly verified by the Senior Officer and after approval is pending before the Illaqa Magistrate for consideration.

After 03 years, the complaint has been filed on the basis of AMIT KAUNDAL 2024.07.12 19:31 | attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document Chandigarh CRM-M-32841-2024 (O & M) -2- which instant FIR was registered with the allegation that the petitioner has prepared forged compromise and committing an offence of cheating and forgery.
3. Notice of motion.

4. On the asking of Court, learned State Counsel appearing on advance notice, accepts notice on behalf of respondent-State and upon instructions from ASI Mukhtiar Singh opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

He submits that the compromise is forged and investigation is required to be Vihan Kanwal vs State Of Punjab And Anr on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87057803/
1 conducted but could not make out a case of custodial interrogation at this stage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, he seeks joining of interrogation of the petitioner for getting the proceedings move in the instant FIR to which counsel for the petitioner undertakes to join and cooperate as and when they are called by the Investigating Officer.

5. Learned counsel for the complainant could not answer the query put by the Court as to for what reasons cutodial interrogation of the petitioner is required at the end of prosecution, who candidly admit that the complainant is nobody to say that custody is required.

6. After having heard learned counsel for the parties and specific stand of learned State Counsel, this Court finds no reason to deny the petitioner the concession of bail, if the petitioner has bona fide intentions and are willing to join the investigation and cooperate for furtherance of the same.

Be that as it may, I am of the considered view that the dispute revolves around execution of an allegedly forged compromise dated 07.03.2022, which is a documentary evidence in nature and is already in possession of the investigating officer handed over by the complainant himself.
AMIT KAUNDAL 2024.07.12 19:31 | attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document Chandigarh CRM-M-32841-2024 (O & M) -3- 7.

Hence, in view of the admitted set of circumstances before this Court, the petitioner is directed to be released on anticipatory bail subject to his joining investigation and reporting to the Investigating Officer concerned within a period of 01 week days from today, on furnishing of personal/surety bonds to the satisfaction of Arresting/Investigating Officer.

The petitioner shall also abide by the terms and conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C.
8.

However, it is made clear that in case the petitioner does not comply with the aforesaid direction of joining the investigation within 01 week, the order passed by this Court today shall automatically stands cancelled.
9. The petition in the aforesaid terms stands allowed.
(SANDEEP MOUDGIL) JUDGE July 12, 2024 A.Kaundal
